The Landlord: Part 2 (Remake)

Hi everyone,

This is a complete remake of the second part of 'The Landlord', serving as a direct continuation of Shawn and Claire's story.
I have completely rebuilt the whole thing from the ground up with zero use of AI and kept the core storyline identical to the original, but lightly polished several scenes and dialogue segments to maximize the visual quality and narrative flow.

You can get the full uncensored version on my Patreon:

Patreon.com/LIZ225A

There's also a fully censored version on:

liz225.fanbox.cc
